import itertools

from copy import deepcopy
from . import utils
from . import pycompat

class Indices(Keys):
    _slice = slice(None)

    def _keys(self, main_value):
        return range(len(main_value))[self._slice]

    def __getitem__(self, item):
        assert isinstance(item, slice)
        result = deepcopy(self)
        result._slice = item
        return result
